title: Dr Somchai (clinician, Chiang Rai, Thailand)
description: Persona: a Thai clinician in Chiang Rai who gives Somsack's Hep B and BCG birth doses and prints the two signed DVCs (J1), and who sees him again a year later at a primary care clinic, reading his record through the VHL (J4.1). Goal: give a non-Thai baby proper care, at birth and when he returns. Needs a way to issue records that travel with the family, a child's full history at the point of care, and confidence the data is authentic. Frustrations: no national id to attach records to; records from abroad he cannot read or verify. Fictional.
